# unp64 (bundled)

UNP64 v2.40, the generic C64 PRG unpacker by iAN CooG (2008-2025), based on the Exomizer 2.0b7 sources by
Magnus Lind. `unp64.exe` is the unchanged Windows build (Jun 3 2025). `unp64.txt` is its documentation, which
includes the authors' notice.

The installer puts this folder at `resources\unp64\` in the install folder. The app points
Settings → Toolchain → Unpacker at it (see `electron/main/settings.ts` and spec 8.11b).

The Exomizer license lets anyone distribute the program freely for non-commercial, non-profit use. The notice must
stay with it, and changed versions must be marked as changed. Do not sell the installer with unp64 in it.
